# Native adjacent traces: executed two-clock results and continuation

Status: ACTUAL_FINITE_NATIVE_EXECUTION_PASS / SHARED_CONTEXT / NOT_ADMITTED. The fixed four-case run completed once. This unit establishes a small ordered-state implementation of two signed return clocks with native exact quotient certificates. It does not complete a factor-blind exponent selector, a general factoring success bound or native Shor. Start with READ_THIS_NEXT_ZH.md for the concise Chinese continuation map; this report supplies the executed results, complete bills and proof boundaries.

## What actually ran

The coordinator's stored ACTUAL_EXECUTION_TOOL_RESULT.json records exec_command chunk c117ac, exit code 0. The unchanged implementation is adjacent_trace.py at SHA-256 d1b0d497ecf8c028e6f4cec8b8322f47d30fa2437c2828825bd79f727d3dda87, with PLAN.md at 590b59350b55e38121c3517cd8c94dd842fd562c0c36aaa619d1b44f4fb9c050. The pre-run peer review is ADJACENT_TRACE_PRE_RUN_REVIEW.md at a42d333b4e288b3cc78e39ee4860bd3f8bcb24e0cc03b66ae6a19a199c1eb635. Their historical code-only markers describe the pre-run records and remain unchanged.

Production carried the ordered pair (V_E,V_(E+1)) using two actual modular multiplications per public bit. For epsilon=+1 and -1 it formed tau=V_E-2epsilon and w=V_(E+1)-epsilon*k, observed dE=gcd(N,tau,w), observed dUnion=gcd(N,w), and recovered dEplus2 by actual positive exact division dUnion/dE. Both signs were evaluated even after a factor appeared. Proper outputs have paid N/factor certificates. Independent full-matrix validation computed both clocks E and E+2, their complete signed ideals, the adjacent traces, exact product and coprimality; this validation is separately charged.

All tuples have k=3 and passed regular setup. The divisors below are saved native outputs, not newly computed references. Each pair is (dE,dEplus2).

| N | E to E+2 | Saved adjacent traces | Positive pair | Negative pair | Positive union |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| 77 | 4 to 6 | (47,46) | (1,1) | (7,1) | 1 |
| 77 | 8 to 10 | (51,3) | (7,11) | (1,1) | 77 |
| 49 | 8 to 10 | (2,45) | (7,1) | (1,1) | 7 |
| 77 | 6 to 8 | (14,73) | (1,7) | (1,1) | 7 |

The N=77,E=8 case is the concrete two-branch result: the scalar section saturates at 77, while the marked first clock and exact quotient retain the coprime divisors 7 and 11. At N=77,E=6 the main positive return is a unit but the quotient exposes the E+2 return divisor 7. This fourth tuple was predeclared for that interface test and has no paired old execution; it is not a random success sample.

The first three cases match the saved frozen free-trace run in all requested common fields: actual setup values, V_E and both signed primitive return divisors/classes. The first case retains its negative return; the prime-power third case retains primitive divisor 7, while the historical ordinary trace observer had saturated at 49. The second case also matches its old main return and adds the executed second-clock quotient. Historical raw bytes were only read after new production and validation completed; the old source was never rerun.

## Complete recorded costs

Numbers in this table are actual retained adder digit replays. Production comprises the first six categories; full-matrix validation is additional work, not a hidden free oracle.

The complete bill is 77,933 digit replays, 827,495 host bit-wiring operations and 13,048 arithmetic bit-length calls. There is one actual native full-adder catalog call followed by its recorded digit compositions; that one catalog call is not a measure of total work. The 28 route instances keep their own arithmetic/gcd/factor certificates. Zero modular-table and inverse use is part of the declared execution, not permission to omit setup or observer costs.

For the three historical pairs, the old polynomial-power component bills were 1,019 / 2,055 / 1,538 digits, versus new adjacent-power bills 605 / 1,123 / 1,007. This is a measured representation-component reduction. The old power returns two matrix-polynomial coefficients; the new power returns adjacent traces. Old extraction of V_E lives in its readout bill. The old complete readout also includes individual-coordinate gcds and ordinary trace gcds, while the new interface instead includes the second clock and exact quotient. The old single-coordinate factor outputs remain visible in saved_baseline_comparison and must not be erased from the comparison.

Complete old production for the three cases was 13,844 digits; new production for those same three cases is 7,861. These are different full interfaces, so no equal-output end-to-end acceleration ratio is claimed. With their respective validators, the old three-case total is 37,719 and the new three-case total is 58,036; the new validation verifies more outputs and costs more. The fourth case is excluded from every paired total. New setup also pays the E+2 integer-addition check after the literally reused old setup subprogram. No historical timing ratio or common-output dependency-closure benchmark was executed. See the frozen EQUAL_OUTPUT_COMPARISON_CONTRACT.md for the exact reporting boundary.

This report's author read the actual summary, actual tool receipt, complete source and comparison contract, and decoded the complete raw JSON for byte/hash/source-binding checks. That work imported only stdlib and did not rerun science. The separate shared-context saved-record review is now complete and passed: read_adjacent_trace_records.py (fbbcc0f5c7282439e2ec2ae8ab098f60eeafee89abdd3fdb26afcbbdcc61f139), ADJACENT_TRACE_RECORD_REVIEW.json (1f4231e16943ff6c5e295fe2fc8e335e9815b5103813cf7813f4b3897254d09f), and ADJACENT_TRACE_EXECUTION_REVIEW.md (2976780270a588354e204ef68154bb86d7db9d00843dfbac6686afbd34b4e760). It consumed all 40 arithmetic streams, 77,933 native-column digit replays, 1,990 typed operations and 1,017 outer wiring nodes, including the adjacent-bit chronology, all exact quotients and full-matrix validation. Neither role is an independent mathematical admission.

The record review also retains an important comparison fact: at old N=77,E=8, an antipodal individual-coordinate observer had already exposed 11. The newly executed result is its explicit primitive two-clock decomposition with complete costs, not a claim that no previous observer found that factor. No failure occurred in the unique run; available-record exception capture was not tested by an injected scientific failure and is not a resumable-interruption guarantee.

The run records the real guard record SHA d7f69e8e5666d281583eb01711b8fa99c8443fb6be99efab8485282c8989eaaf, guard-file SHA 92b8debca3fdc11ad8cdbb56c417b3de3e2c76007f788c84ffec3d2f5449f3b9, and coordinator-supplied knowledge snapshot 8c23cca3ed79ca2d6ecbdf76734606eabd94fd0d. The author's separately refreshed b304760 snapshot and all older proof markers remain separately identified. No later source or authority value is retroactively substituted into these records.

## New symbolic frontier, distinguished from execution

- ADJACENT_TRACE_HBW_GEOMETRY.md (3b8083eb0ecddc1c12406cd64113ce3e2bb88ee676a0e7b8fd3f7c6289511e14), with its review, proves that the ordered trace pair is an invertible residue chart of the cyclic HBW mark. It preserves the conic with unit norm -Delta. The binary updates are not the original integer-unimodular one-step move. Inversion preserves the main return but exchanges the E+2 and E-2 sections; the richer output requires orientation.
- CONIC_RESIDUAL_COCYCLE.md (2bda2beb4ef90fbc93078c1c52efe1b23872379cca3b53cdd1414a550cddd491), with its review, proves F(D0)=v^2F and F(D1)=w^2F for arbitrary input states. This retains a meaningful nonzero defect law. A later zero defect does not certify earlier membership when a multiplier was nonunit. A runtime defect/product observer has not been implemented or charged in this run.
- EXACT_TRACE_PARAMETER_FIBERS.md (88bb76916b9d844d5763d4120668ac85531005155cf36e8bb33a44d829894dd9), with its review, counts regular trace fibers exactly using the cyclic groups of sizes p-1 and p+1. Under its stated conditional uniform CRT law, resolving two clock labels adds the exact separation probability a_p b_q+b_p a_q over the union-only observer. No random sampler or density experiment ran here; small fixed clocks still have small large-prime fibers.
- JACOBI_TORUS_SELECTOR.md (30fc0de14df7eef7f43c30838fbe1dd47c60db85982ac5d92bfc0c863d2cdf2f), with its author self-review, identifies an already implemented typed Jacobi interface for a future selector. Under the external promise N=pq with distinct Blum primes, Jacobi(k^2-4,N)=-1 forces opposite torus types. A dyadic signed main return can then only hit the nonsplit component and cannot saturate N. This does not force a hit: the odd part of the local order remains. The second clock generally has an odd factor, so the main-clock no-saturation guarantee cannot be copied to its union. The new Jacobi integration was not executed here.
- PUBLIC_JACOBI_CLOCK_FIBERS.md (d3fbce534cc26e41146242cc97a7527b92054fa67eddae50fd7b15854094c3e9), reviewed in PUBLIC_JACOBI_CLOCK_REVIEW.md (6539135bf19c363e96dc9099f718500a58e41d5d9fe5249431c934ce3788ca19), supplies the factor-blind public clock E=N-Jacobi(Delta,N). For a squarefree product of two distinct odd primes, both local kernel sizes equal d=gcd(p-sigma_p,q-sigma_q); at most one component admits a negative return. Thus the primitive negative divisor cannot saturate N, without a Blum promise. The exact conditional label counts are proved, but a small d still gives small or empty useful fibers. This clock and its selector were not executed in the four-case run.
- DOUBLING_COVER_CHARACTER.md (1a1fc07a5e69abc10756538b46bc14be0e74c5c0d2f88af7886f5a4b86d97e94), with DOUBLING_COVER_CHARACTER_PARENT_REVIEW.md (daa99f759eb44b2468ae32a1c0557373f11fae408900c76e55f667a04fb859d5), proves Legendre(k+2) is exactly the local torus square-class character in both split and nonsplit types. Its nonsquare class has maximal 2-primary order, but the exact conditional return rate still contains the unknown odd-part factor gcd(B,m)/m, with the stated exceptional-root correction. Global Jacobi products do not reveal each component or construct square roots. Forward doubling does not supply independent new square-class bits. This is a completed symbolic tool contract, not an executed new native character program.
- INTRINSIC_DOUBLING_AND_NORMAL_DEFECT.md (bb84d2d716fae955a5a32adeba4f597d2bf0dd6d12721e04d16dc9b169607e47), with INTRINSIC_DOUBLING_REVIEW.md (db8094d88b6403efb81e35326846389ee67c930998f12a7c741b829afb226880), identifies the two bit maps on the admitted smooth conic as intrinsic finite etale covers of degree two. Their invariant differential has multiplier 2; v^2 and w^2 multiply the conormal defect instead. Ambient Jacobian degeneracy is therefore not an orbit singularity. Rational lifting still needs a character/root contract, and the split chart is a proof device rather than factor or square-root input to the program. The review includes actual primary-source reading for the standard etale/descent steps; no new scientific run accompanies it.

These are standard trace, torus and character structures placed under explicit native observer and cost contracts. They are not newly invented classical mechanisms, physical-attribution proofs or a general Shor simulation claim. The current factor objective remains open at parameter/exponent selection and total useful work, rather than at recovering these particular two-clock ideals.

## Continue from the saved frontier

Do not rerun the four verified fixtures or delete STARTED to create a new run. Consume the exact source, raw records and final record review. A changed algorithm or output contract belongs in a new independent unit with its own pins, predeclared inputs and actual guard. Any authorized later conversation can continue; no original driver/researcher session is required.

The doubling-cover character and intrinsic geometry are now proved and reviewed. The next independent unit is the exact joint-character fiber law: condition on both actually accessible Jacobi(k+2,N) and Jacobi(k^2-4,N), retain the correct orientation/class weights, and count the primitive positive/negative return labels under the public E=N-j clock or a predeclared odd-cofactor schedule. Single-filter or unconditional formulas must not be reused after a second filter without rederiving the law. That successor is being developed separately in sep27-brc-character-fibers and is not included as a result of this frozen unit.

The useful open tool obligation is then specific: provide a factor-blind, costed way to enlarge or exploit useful odd-order return fibers, rather than merely distinguishing the 2-primary cover branch. A native integration must charge both character evaluations, setup rejection/factor outcomes, public exponent construction, every attempted proposal and the chosen signed observers; it must not receive p, q, their torus orders, roots or a favorable parameter distribution for free. A proof of larger conditional fibers is distinct from an actual algorithm that samples them. Further work can change the geometric family or observable, but should state the newly required native interface and its verifiable invariant before running it.
